name: ac-interrogation
description: Interrogate an idea, plan, or decision before commitment: structured questioning that surfaces assumptions, maps failure modes, tests evidence, forces alternatives, and closes without looping. Eight leaves: interrogation-protocol (session order, cold read, time-box), question-craft (past behaviour over hypotheticals, follow-ups), assumption-audit (load-bearing assumptions, confidence labels), failure-mapping (pre-mortem, inversion, base rates), evidence-dial (falsification test, decide-vs-research gate), alternative-forcing (three alternatives plus do-nothing), steelman-discipline (attack the strongest version), close-and-stop (stop criteria, anti-loop cap, assumption ledger, kill criteria). Use when asking 'grill me on my plan', 'stress-test this idea', 'poke holes in this', 'interrogate this decision', 'what am I missing', 'challenge my assumptions'. Not for: reviewing an existing artifact (use ac-code-review), open-ended research (use ac-deep-researcher), or writing requirements (use ac-spec-writing).
